horizon_note: h counts tradable bars, not calendar bars (R4). Mask-off these coincide; recorded so the convention behind these numbers is stated rather than inferred.
n_permutations_note: The original run used 1000. The permutation null is a separate statistic computed from shuffled signals and does not enter the E-Ratio of the real signal set; all three E-Ratios reproduce to float equality at n=1.
